title: aster laevis subsp. geyeri
intro: Aster laevis subsp. geyeri, commonly known as the smooth aster or smooth American-aster, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the management of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Aster laevis subsp. geyeri include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
